fixes.C1: Onboarding secrets remain in document memory, never router history. Completion, exit and visibility/page lifecycle clear them. Lost creation acknowledgements cannot replay creation.
fixes.C2: Wallet-managed P256 setup rejects any externally supplied initial config before WebAuthn or installation; ECDSA external-owner consent remains explicit.
fixes.C3: Validate approved-account paths/public keys/spent scripts, strip every foreign signing hint before private-key use, require at least one approved input when unfinished inputs exist, and restore only public metadata afterward. Joint transactions keep foreign inputs unsigned; root derivation remains restricted.
fixes.C4: New passkey registrations use independent random handles and preserve prior credentials still needed by another chain or composite policy.
fixes.C5: Pending or cancelled UI state never authorizes credential deletion; public pending records are persisted before installation and adoption precedes hydration.
fixes.C6: Core returns actual storage write/removal promises; migrations await persistence and optional diagnostic failures are handled. Fresh-vault salt and ciphertext are encrypted first and committed in one native batch; sequential-only adapters fail before writing.
fixes.C7: New writes require WebCrypto/AES-GCM; authenticated historical 20000-round profile is recorded before rewrap, retaining old account-key access and retry after interruption.
fixes.C8: Trezor preserves locktime and sequence zero and verifies all unsigned transaction fields before accepting returned witnesses.
